document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The Top of Aten is in Jeffries’ footlocker! How it gleams! It is 
somehow purer than pure crystal. You instinctively feel it is both 
very beautiful and very powerful.
Make a Luck roll: if you fail, Jeffries appears before you can 
deal with the Top, go to 578; if you succeed, you have time to 
choose the Top’s fate—read on:
To keep the Top and try to sell it back home, go to 544. To 
pick up the hammer nearby and try to smash the Top, go to 591. 
To go to ‘A’-deck and chuck the Top over the side and into the 
sea, go to 433.
(537)
